modes.description: Uses the committed Capsule Lab v1 row without additional stress multipliers.
modes.label: Nominal evidence

modes.description: Broad conservative posture across assumption-bound material, media, and environment terms.
modes.label: Skeptical evidence

modes.description: Stress case for interstellar dust density, velocity coupling, and shielding extrapolation.
modes.label: Severe dust

modes.description: Stress case where archive-media persistence dominates data-integrity loss.
modes.label: Media decay

modes.description: Stress case for radiative dose and plasma-coupled electronics/media damage.
modes.label: Radiation stress

failure_modes.description: Reduced-order dust-tail pressure derived from source-backed environment proxies and shield assumptions.
failure_modes.label: Dust and large-particle impact pressure

failure_modes.description: Dose stress hook over archive media and materials; not full radiation transport.
failure_modes.label: Radiation dose pressure

failure_modes.description: Plasma density and charging stress are sampled as proxy drivers, not as validated multiphysics transport.
failure_modes.label: Plasma and charging pressure

failure_modes.description: Long-horizon material persistence is represented by bounded priors pending qualification evidence.
failure_modes.label: Deep-time material degradation

failure_modes.description: Media-retention margin and redundancy are sampled, but bit-level recoverability is not proven.
failure_modes.label: Archive media integrity loss

failure_modes.description: Rows expose selected target and flight horizon so reviewers can reject hidden defaults.
failure_modes.label: Target and horizon mismatch

failure_modes.description: Radiation, plasma, thermal, and material coupling remain outside the v1 artifact.
failure_modes.label: Full multiphysics transport

failure_modes.description: The artifact has no coupon or stack test data over the full velocity and angle envelope.
failure_modes.label: Stack-level ballistic-limit validation

failure_modes.description: ECC, physical media readout, and post-arrival decoding are not empirically validated here.
failure_modes.label: Bit-level archive recovery validation

failure_modes.description: Launch provider, legal, regulatory, navigation, telemetry, and operations readiness are out of scope.
failure_modes.label: Launch and operations readiness

interpretation_limits: Reduced-order Monte Carlo summary; not hardware qualification or mission certification.
Driver shares expose assumption sensitivity, not measured failure attribution.
Attack modes are deterministic review postures for claim criticism.

qualification_roadmap.acceptance_criteria: Source-backed dust density and large-particle tail bounds for selected target corridors.
Coupon and stack impact evidence over relevant velocity, mass, and angle regimes.
Material/media dose model tied to transport simulation or test-backed dose envelopes.
Accelerated aging and redundancy evidence that can replace assumption-bound media priors.
End-to-end encode, damage, readout, ECC, and decode tests under expected degradation.
Independent review of assumptions, targetability, launch feasibility, and public claims.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Target, horizon, velocity, capsule profile, and attack mode are explicit.
Probability bands are finite and bounded in [0, 1].
External evidence gaps remain linked before any qualification claim is allowed.
Row blocks certification, qualification, flight-readiness, and guaranteed-recovery claims.

evidence_needed.needed: Deep-time material aging evidence that can replace bounded degradation priors.
Encode/readout/ECC recovery data under expected media damage states.
Measured dust density and large-particle tail for the selected corridor.
Radiation transport or test-backed dose envelopes for selected materials and media.

qualification_roadmap.label: Archive media retention and redundancy aging campaign

classes.claim_boundary: May anchor a local model input; does not certify a deep-time mission row.
classes.meaning: Direct source or close reference environment supports the value.

classes.claim_boundary: Must remain labeled as extrapolation, never as direct measurement of the selected mission.
classes.meaning: A source-backed or heritage value is used with declared applicability limits.

classes.claim_boundary: Requires visible evidence gaps and cannot support certification language.
classes.meaning: A bounded prior or reduced-order coefficient is used because direct evidence is absent.

classes.claim_boundary: Must expose the mix instead of collapsing it into a single confidence badge.
classes.meaning: The row or mode combines multiple evidence classes.

rules: Realistic rows must not depend on speculative or trust-D inputs.
Proxy values must not be renamed as measured values.
Assumption-bound values must remain visible in row evidence and blocking-claim fields.
Rows with missing evidence must carry a blocking evidence gap instead of a stronger public claim.
